notes.title: WarpedSpace - More August Dev Progress 2025
notes.content:
🪐 WarpedSpace - August Dev Progress 
August 8 – August 19th, 2025🚀

Hey Space Pilots! 
Here’s what I've been working on since the last update:
⚙️ Base Building & Structures
Transfer Dock is now buildable with the build tool.

Added Base Building Tasks to the task list.

Transfer Dock currently limited to (Ice Fragments & Plasma Canisters) for now.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/0c0342713e3eff135e1c6705f04352fa142607b1.png"]
🌌 Gameplay & World
Added Aluminum Nodes for mining.

Began work on New Biome Variation 1.

Started development of the Mobile Resource Compactor (mining & transporting bulk goods).
🛰️ Ships & Tools
Ship Tractor Beams updated:

Collect more item types.

Behavior is more predictable.

Auto-disables when ship storage is full.



Salvage Tool now constantly shows target salvage % and progress bar.

Fixed a bug where Left Click Schematic didn’t always work.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/58223db2e110b34a836daf9486a1f9bedb0f4184.png"]
📊 UI & UX Improvements
Opening Tasks will now close Space Comms, and vice versa.

Fixed Keybind overlay.

Ship Hull Critical Warning moved to a more appropriate visibility level.
🔧 Bug Fixes & Improvements
Fixed issues with Purifier / Refinery and Storage interaction.

Storage can now be closed with F/Interact.

Fixed long term bug where storage could only be accessed once.

ADS updated - now limited to weapons only.
[hr][/hr]
Thanks again for playing WarpedSpace the Feedback is Important. 
More content, polish, and surprises are on the way. Stay tuned and keep exploring!


🪐 Keep your eyes on the stars,
 – WarpedSpaceDev

notes.title: WarpedSpace - Monthly Dev Report July 14 – August 8, 2025
notes.content:
🪐 WarpedSpace - Monthly Dev Report
July 14 – August 8, 2025

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/d4f9427b86b526a7ab29dd926945b46e3238e7f9.png"]
[hr][/hr]🧠 AI & Hostile Upgrades
Introduced new hostile variants, including advanced bunker/station turrets.

Hostiles spawn behavior added for dynamic encounters (one creature so far)

FPS Hostiles are now tracked for better mission integration.
[hr][/hr]🔐 Keycard & Door Access System
Doors now support keycard-based interactions:

Players must hold a key to unlock certain doors.

Keys are consumed upon use, adding tactical planning to exploration.

Keycards placed for testing across various Bunkers
[hr][/hr]🧱 Advanced Base Building System
Major improvements to the Base Core and Advanced Build Tools:

Base parts now include Triangle Floors, Arches, Beveled Floor & Wall Panels.

Red Build Dots show contextually.

Removed parts are now properly deregistered from base system.

Solved a major issue blocking Advanced Base Building.

Build Tool now:

Includes new Steam Achievement 

Has bug fixes and slight performance improvements.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/98c6be4cddee8d433a72cae48bd1467510202875.jpg"]
[hr][/hr]🗂 Task System & Progression
New Task Types:

Find a Research Item.

Locate a Ship’s Primary Weapon.

Build with the Tool.

Perform Item Analysis.
[hr][/hr]🔊 Immersion & Feedback Enhancements
Audio alerts added:

When oxygen is low or depleted.

Various 1-time notification were added

Improved:

UI prompts for scanning, tools, and interactions.

Status system cleanup to prevent redundant warnings.

"Boundary Message" now reflects Playtest / Demo 

A few voice lines updated from Voice Actor 

Various Ui elements were updated: first tasks list, tooltips etc

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/07e6b3298c5238c187f3fc08ef087d918823d552.png"]
[hr][/hr]🛠 Tooling & Salvage Updates
Salvage Tool:

Optimized detection.

Fixed ghost object bug when fully salvaged.

Repair Tool:

Tiered repair capability.

eg. Restore camera drone to full health but ship to 80% 

Mining Tool:

Schematic now discoverable via mining node scanning.
[hr][/hr]🧃 Survival Systems
Hydration:

More aspects coming online now with triggers warnings when low.

Including supporting gameplay

Water Purifier:

Is now craftable via the Build Tool

Hydration Pack:

Now craftable 

Added Hydration Task as part of survival training

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/3cad020b451d7b730ccfb44ef424236bf601794b.png"]
[hr][/hr]🧍‍♂️ Player Movement
Added Dash Mechanic: (Testing Phase)

Double-tap movement + boost = Dash.

Works in both EVA & FPS modes.

Includes SFX and prevents spam.

Player is invulnerable during dash.
[hr][/hr]🚀 Ship Systems
Ship Hull/Armor health now persists between sessions.

Ships in new games start with damaged hull (story element - your task as always is to repair it )

Damage VFX Added (to be improved)

New Flyable Ship with interior added as a Story Element.

Ship Storage:

Can now eject items into space.

Can no longer transfer items to player if it exceeds inventory volume.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/9bfa36b6f397d86b679b91878f1f0d3577e911c6.png"]
[hr][/hr]🔄 Inventory & Resource Systems
Items now:

Show % bar and capacity values (e.g., 50 / 100).

Have individual max capacity limits.

Recycling items now reflects reduced returns or no return if applicable.

Inventory Transfer:

Cleaner separation between Placing and Ejecting items.

Bug fixes and volume enforcement.
[hr][/hr]🔥 Plasma Harvester System Expansion
Introduced systems related to Plasma Collection and Handling:

Plasma Harvester is now craftable via build tool

Placed over a vent will cause the harvester to produce Plasma Canisters

Plasma Canisters can now be:

Moveable via the Tractor Tool  only (not hand-collectable)

Transferred into Base Storage via the Transfer Dock.

Transfer Dock is now:

Fully buildable using the Build Tool.

Integrated into the base system with visual and functional tracking.

With proper plasma containment and transfer logistics now in place, expect further expansions to plasma harvesting, refining, and tech crafting in future updates.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/ec623a87c964ad330445b8b4b948468d00373d67.jpg"]


[hr][/hr]🔌 Transfer Dock System
Transfer Dock Update:

Transfers Plasma Canisters and other items into Base Storage.

Tracks item charge levels.

Now buildable via Build Tool.

     This will lead into powering your base and other base requirements coming to WarpedSpace

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/4e93222cc62bab1ecfa5ab67c7290ead9b9aa247.jpg"]


[hr][/hr]✅ Highlight Feature
Dash Mechanic with Invulnerability (Feedback Appreciated)
Gives players a responsive, high-risk, high-reward movement option — both stylish and strategic
[hr][/hr]📅 Looking Ahead
The past month introduced powerful new gameplay systems, from base building improvements and survival mechanics to ship and hostile behavior enhancements. With keycard systems, resource control, and fine-tuned inventory management, WarpedSpace is "rapidly" becoming a deep, immersive survival experience ( well at least I think so )
[hr][/hr]

Thanks again for playing WarpedSpace the Feedback is Important. 
More content, polish, and surprises are on the way. Stay tuned and keep exploring!


See you in the void,
 – WarpedSpaceDev

notes.title: WarpedSpace - Monthly Dev Report June 20 – July 13, 2025
notes.content:
🪐 WarpedSpace - Monthly Dev Report
June 20 – July 13, 2025                                                                                               -  Latest Build : 722
[hr][/hr]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/5645d9396a8456c64f5604623712109a77761ef4.png"]
🧩 Mission System Overhaul
Major expansion to the Mission & Story System:

Now tracks item collection, door states, hostile stats.

Supports mission resets for replay-ability where applicable.

New missions and locations added, including bunkers and abandoned stations.
[hr][/hr]

🧰 Gameplay Systems & Mechanics
Bug Fixes:

Resolved a critical issue causing mission content to spawn in triplicate.

Fixed bugs with research, hacking, tool state logic and other small fixes.

Interactivity Improvements:

Enhanced prompts for scanning and interaction.

Doors, lights, and gravity systems now respond to mission and player states.

Configurable door animation speed.

Tractor & Salvage Tools:

Added weld cutting, hinge/joint breakdowns.

Salvage tools now affect crafted pools.

Tractor Tool now includes position and rotation modes



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/cc926daa639e0464b2250e31dbb8f77a28482b59.png"]


[hr][/hr]
                                
🛠 Item & Inventory Enhancements
Inventory System Rework:

Item stacking and splitting in player and ship storage.

Volume tracking added.

UI upgrades for inventory, ship storage, and volume display.

"Inventory Full" audio feedback added.

Added Inventory Upgrade Module.

Storage Systems:

Storage locker and ship storage limits introduced.

Expanded UI readouts and gravity-aware item interactions.

                              [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/7ebd48e519df1ba832f70ec70e1d22f9c03c5f91.png"]
[hr][/hr]

🔥 Heat System Introduced
Systems, modules, and weapons now generate heat.

Heat is tracked on a new Heat Readout, with EM value displayed.

Ship Cooler Module added to manage temperature buildup.
                               [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/597d831dfeca4a35a3bebdc145d60204743722a7.png"] [hr][/hr]🔫 Suit & Weaponry
Added 3x new Suit Armors.

Introduced new weapon with improved loading mechanics and one that uses ammo.

Weapons using ammo can now be loaded/unloaded.

Hand weapons now auto-align to crosshair.
[hr][/hr]🛰 Environment & Locations
Multiple new locations added and expanded.

Magnetic Field Asteroids updated.

Improved loading performance for locations.
[hr][/hr]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/7556688f922c6a8f3645e31089ab0943f456070d.png"]


🤖 Hostiles & Drones
Added drone variant and a new hostile type.

FPS Hostiles improved and system jitter reduced.
[hr][/hr]
                             
🗂 UI & Task Management
Task List improvements:

Tracks "collect over time" goals.

Task List visuals improved

Updated visuals for interaction prompts and tooltips.

                                [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/1f76f893a0def5ce009f11777d16c02cf1407b12.png"]      
[hr][/hr]🔧 Quality of Life
Build Tool now respects radiation zones (lore-based restriction).

Items marked as scannable more consistently.

Code cleanup and internal optimization pass.

Tools no longer run when unequipped.
[hr][/hr]✅ Highlight
“Build Tool now fails in radiation zones due to lore reasons”
Immersion and lore integration continues to evolve alongside core mechanics.
[hr][/hr]📅 Looking Ahead
With continued expansion to mission systems, dynamic environments, and core survival mechanics, WarpedSpace is steadily approaching a robust, feature-complete alpha. July’s work laid critical foundations for scalable gameplay, deeper interactivity, and performance improvements across the board.
[hr][/hr]

Thanks again for playing Warped Space the Feedback is Important. 
More content, polish, and surprises are on the way. Stay tuned and keep exploring!


See you in the void,
 – WarpedSpaceDev

notes.title: WarpedSpace - Patch Notes Build 690
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/e41aa0f1921343b5d549f8d7d4953ddb0137c81f.png"]

🚀 Warped Space - Build: 690 - Patch Notes: 

Date Range: May 27 – June 20, 2025

Hey explorers! We've been hard at work improving core systems, expanding survival mechanics, and fixing long-standing issues. This update brings the first pass of the Base Building Tool update, as building is now via the Build Tool. Also improvements such as quality-of-life upgrades, hydration survival mechanics, new hostile lifeforms, and more.

⚒️ Build Tool Snap System (Prototype) Added – Early stages of snapping for build tool for more intuitive base construction.

🧱 Fixed base component power distribution – newly placed components now receive power from the base manager

🧰 Base Fabricator Fixes:

Now buildable again.

No longer duplicates items.

UI updated.

🧹 Storage cleanup improvements: deleted items are now removed and storage transfer is smoother (1-at-a-time logic).

🌱 New Modules & Systems:

Planter added to Research HAB.

Hydro Incubator and Base Refinery are now buildable.

Planting cycle introduced; supports multiple item types.

⚒️ The Forge has been slightly improved and it awaiting playtest feedback 

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/0b22853d48c8da2f9911b044e1cec7163b9ec7a1.png"]

🧬 Auto Research bugs squashed.

🧾 Default Schematics now behave like normal schematics.

📜 Mission system improvements:

Missions can now reward research unlocks.

Added one new mission, removed one outdated.

Updated and fixed multiple test mission locations.

Fixed beacon markers and hostile DPS readouts.


Worm Added to remote asteroid caves 😉

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/e4f6d32ecfe52356807e6eddb165e60b8dd2acb6.png"]


New Locations to explore in the works:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/66ff8f5bf2c75118acd91d283bf772cb66a7d381.png"]

Monitor hydration status through new UI badge.

🧴 Craftable Water Bottles:

Right-click to drink.

🧪 Water Purifier module added for testing.

🔈 Added eating and drinking SFX.

🔧 Various fixes to consumption logic and hydration effects.



Water Purifier Added

Craft water bottles and fill them with water purified from ice fragment.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/bcf01d03a3ccbc87b35413c337ece3183170deac.png"]

👨‍🚀 Exit to EVA check, now functions correctly while docked in space dock.

🧬 Updated creature blink behavior.

🧠 Optimized databank entry logic.

🎨 UI & Icon improvements.

🧠 Keybind error checking added.

⚙️ Numerous bugfixes across gameplay systems.

🛠️ Fixed: Salvage tool not salvaging !

⚙️Improved Interactions with: Doors, Gravity, Lights etc.

⚙️Major Bug Fixed - with streaming in location from disc, with the knock on effect of fixing

 audio logs to play 3 times

notes.title: WarpedSpace - Patch Notes Build 642d
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/03d4a7f075cb968eab78df8f3cf1088b637228ed.png

🚀 Greetings Explorers!
This update is packed with:  mission system improvements, bug fixes, UI updates, and expansions to core gameplay systems like building, scanning, EVA and now access to the new Forge System! [Testing Phase] 
 Thanks for all your continued support and feedback!

🌌 Story & Mission System
Story System Updated now supports multi-system missions and improvements to the current mission/story system.
Skimmer Missions – Introduced with supporting content.
Improved Mission System UX – Tasks and markers better reflect mission states.
Hostile Skimmer – Introduced with mission integration.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/2f0ddf74312dd44852495a5e3b990df4be7b769c.png

🏗️ Base Building & Construction
Base Building Mechanics Improved:
- Materials are now consumed during construction.
- Deconstruction implemented.
- Storage Items must be empty to be removed.
- Habitats can only be removed if anything built inside them has been removed.
- Added banners for Construction/Deconstruction status and material usage.
- Added Build Error Sound for better feedback.

Buildable Base Modules Added
Planter, Base Fabricator, Regen Pod, Small Habitat, Storage Shelf, Storage Locker
Base Shields & Shield Modules
- Feature Proximity-based On/Off.

General Improvements
Gravity and Air simulation improved.
Updated help panel and dynamic tooltips for Build Tool and other modes.
Help Panels – Now dynamically reflect context and added Regen Pod help.
Action Prompts Improved
- Now linked to Range Finder marker.
- Updated to support each tool context.
- Fixed flickering when tractoring.
- Wall of Debris – Now pushable.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/50a31a47d5d582f89536e264ebac90eb0724c8c3.png

🧪 Research System
UI Updates
Cleaner interface.
Research Now Reveals schematic requirements
Removed % once research is complete.
Added filters for better navigation.


🧠 Ship & EVA Updates
EVA Boost Improved
- Smoother ramp-up and better speed gain.
- Slower oxygen drain.
- New VFX and Camera Shake (toggle option coming soon™).

Agility Module Improvements
- More accurately affect strafe speeds.
Fixed bug where movement suddenly became too sensitive.
Ion Field Effect – Updated to impact ship speed correctly.
Shield Bug Fix – Ship is no longer indestructible if shield was 0 HP but active.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/1cd2560b194ac4db82cdabea13568134f9496c38.png

🌠 Null Space & Warp Gates
Null Space Warp Gates Re-Implemented
- Now uses new gate tech.
- Return gate updated.
- Improved transitions and visuals.
- Large Warper NPC Squid - can now drop warp tunnels again.

System Updates
Meteoroids now remain in their system when jumping
Skyboxes now update properly when returning from Null Space.

📡 Scanning & Exploration
Scanning Update 
 - Supports both Passive and Active Scanning.
 - Item Scan Progress now persists


 🛠️ Added Forge System 🛠️ 
Now testable via [F5]
The ability to Merge Ship Expansion Modules 
Improve the ships performance in almost every way
Agility, Rate of Fire, Armor Regen, Weapon Energy Pool 
and much more!

🐛 Bug Fixes
Fixed long-standing shield/armor bug making ships invulnerable.
Ship computer now marks collectibles without needing to re-board.

Thanks again for playing Warped Space the Feedback is Important. 
More content, polish, and surprises are on the way. Stay tuned and keep exploring!

- Warped Space Dev

notes.content:

WarpedSpace - Patch Notes Build 588d

🛠️ Warped Space - Patch Notes (Mar 26 – Apr 13, 2025)

✨ Some Highlights
New Hostile Space Squid Variant added.
Shield Modules are now lootable again!

Transfer Dock added to the Starter Base.
- currently only transfers Ice fragments to the Oxygen Tank.

New Base Building Template (Part 1) with partial load-in and construction updates.
Added De-Construct VFX to Build Tool (Temp) for a more visual experience.
Re-added the ability to remove built items.

Added DeConstructor to Ship Panel – break down unwanted items.
Ice Fragments now spawn near the starter base (testing phase).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/123e9e5e2f186383cc0ffe9905af03e2fc1da5d9.png

⚙️ Gameplay & Balance
Ships can no longer shoot through hollow asteroids.

Most Hostiles now guards areas and won’t chase players forever.
- Targeting range reduced for said hostiles.

Game now checks inventory/equipped items to auto-complete already completed first tasks.

Base Oxygen will now only reduce while the player is inside the base.
- Base oxygen levels can no longer go negative.

🧠 NPC's & Missions
Mission system now prevents preloading areas that are too far away.
Fighter spawn parameters updated for better balance.

Fixed a bug where "First Tasks" got stuck on: Research Scanning Tool.

🛠️ UI / UX Improvements
Inventory stacking now displays correctly without needing a refresh.
Inventory now shows accurate item counts.

Base Manager will now only display Base Modules.
New tooltip system applied to ship setup and base modules (Refinery, Fabricator).

Fabricator UI opens/closes more consistently.

Build Tool UI Updated: Includes ESC-to-exit, improved hints, and feedback.
Build Tool can now deconstruct incomplete builds.
Tool Wheel unequip now holsters tool before unequipping.

🔊 Audio Updates
Ship collision audio now reflects impact speed.
Drone probe sounds updated to sound more accurate; adjusted audio range.

🧊 Visual & Effects
Updated Ion Field effect on ship engines.
Updated : Improved interiors, animated doors, and enhanced lighting.

🐛 Bug Fixes
Fixed bug where ship became 'slippery' after Eject.
Fixed Starter Base door issue.
Fixed a tractor beam visual glitch when switching targets.
Fixed character module equipping issue on first-time play.
Fixed long-standing bug with persistent item deletion, which also affected looting respawn capsules.
Close button tooltips no longer lingers.

Saving system improved: now handles HDD full and keeps a backup file.

Base Manager and Oxygen Systems stability fixes.

⚡ Performance
Minor optimizations across the board.
Improved performance with data lookups.


Thank you for your continued support 🚀 
Keep the feedback coming!```

notes.title: Warped Space Demo Update - Build 527b
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/7b5d6f7a8175d2ab5de7b9bda387f822d920d843.png

📢 Warped Space Demo - Patch Notes (Build 527b) 📢


🚀 Bug Fixes & Quality of Life Improvements
Fixed a bug where pressing ESC while in Interact Mode would lock the player.
ESC now properly closes more UI elements, including:
Ship Setup, Base Fabricator, Base Refinery

Fixed an issue where removing the rebreather would cause max oxygen to drop to an old default.
Fixed a bug preventing some items from appearing in Schematics.
Fixed CO2 Scrubber crafting issue.
Fixed Ion Drive Repair message.
Fixed inventory-related issues.

🛠 UI & Input Improvements
Added a Ship Storage Close Button for convenience.
Integrated Top Menu Buttons into the Inventory Panel (TABS).
Updated UI Inputs while in the Feedback Dialog (now properly enabled/disabled).

Added more Info Graphics to improve onboarding for new players.
Helper text no longer covers the Modules Button.
Added a Continue Button to the loading screen and cinematic placeholder flow.

⚙️ Gameplay & Mechanics
Ship External Panel: Players can now remove and install Power Cores via the external panel. 
The system will automatically replace the core with the best one found in the inventory.
Respawn Capsule Update: Players can no longer transfer items into the Respawn Capsule—only extraction is allowed.
Item Charge Bar: Now properly displays a max limit of 100%.
Rebalanced Starter Area Sentry Drone Drops.
Gravity Fixes: Gravity has been fixed in both the upper and lower levels of the Starter Base.

🏗️ Environment & World Updates
Updated Default Space Dock and surrounding areas.
Increased the size of Space Docks slightly.
🔑 Keybind Updates (Defaults—won't affect existing installations unless reset)

TAB → Opens Inventory (New Default)

Greetings, Warped Space adventurers! 🚀

We've been hard at work throughout August, bringing new features, updates to enhance your deep-space exploration experience. Here's a breakdown of what’s new:

Space Dock & Visual Updates
Space Dock Overhaul: Updated both Damaged Space Dock and regular Space Dock visuals and icons, ensuring a more polished look.

Item Marker Fixes: Resolved issues with blue item markers and icon sizes, alongside improvements to visual displays.

New Card System: Introduced a card system, initially tested with discovered objects to streamline your inventory and exploration management.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/a2baf77d478c6700f4a65ceb276c554cac7f9de2.png

New Tools & Mechanics
Hand Tractor Tool: Added with distance control, smoother movement, basic VFX, and tool schematics for crafting.

Tractor Capture Bubble: New feature added to capture items being tractored to your ship’s storage, making resource collection more efficient.

Vertical Hanger Prototype: Watch as the floor auto-ascends when your ship is not docked, and take advantage of new hanger mechanics that integrate floor movement with docking procedures.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/03047a518ab0194ec6f50b633b845747c41f71e3.png

Modules & Enhancements
Tracking Disruptor Module: Added a new module to help you disrupt enemies.

Expansion Slots: Three new expansion slots added to further customize your ship.

Updated Module Readouts: Now shows percentage bonuses for Rate of Fire, Damage, and other stats. Confirmed that these bonuses are being correctly applied.

PowerCore Degradation: Introduced wear and tear mechanics for the PowerCore, with visual feedback in the UI and the ability to repair at space docks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/1050a6b3bd7198d9ae6576603acb1df5a5b6f731.png

New Audio Logs & Ship Banner Updates: 
- Added audio logs for scanning the Damaged Space Dock, 
  alongside new exit and engine toggle key prompts in the ship banner Ui.

Oxygen Mechanics: Added a small grace period after oxygen depletion, giving you a moments after the screen goes blank.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/e9ff878b0e2ec7041f1a196dd66af041e7789b58.png


Added a new secret location and props, along with more surprises for you to discover!

Thank you for your continued support and feedback! Your input is invaluable in making Warped Space the best game it can be. As always, stay tuned for more updates, and happy exploring!

notes.title: Progress Report #8
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/adacaca36bdebfce561e9b08cebc21753d89c4ac.png

Greetings, fellow space explorers! It's time for another thrilling update on our sci-fi space survival game. We've been hard at work fleshing out the game. Here's what we've accomplished over the last few months:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/7c8578bbc4edf490efaa3c9aa248ae562398f18c.png
Latest progress and improvement made to the early stages of the game plus quality of life updates


1. UI & HUD Enhancements:

Added UI Markers for improved navigation and feedback.
Improved HUD and Banner Notifications to enhance user experience.
Implemented Scanning and Analysis features in the UI, adding meta data and object detection info to the ship's HUD.
Module Stats now appear in ToolTips and comparison panels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/fd2bfb0ff18de21395fe914373840acc51f49b0c.png

Also updated Steam Achievements, including new icons for a more polished look.

2. Mission/Story System Updates:

Expanded Mission and Story System to track the location of spawned hostiles and manage loot distribution. Progressive markers were added for mission clarity.
Hostiles now scale dynamically depending on threat level,  scaling in speed, shields, armor, and weapons.

Updated Mission System with hybrid scanning/combat modes and improved hostile ship management
to manage frequency and number of hostiles you might encounter.

3. Ship and Combat Enhancements:

Reworked Ship Weapons/Modules to improve on/off states and displays, with further improvements to the weapon system.
Added Combat Info Panel for better situational awareness during combat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/c32e2734057cc690fd56ea2c1bcb56219beffdb0.png

Tiered Ship Modules no longer stack on collection, and new RNG stats now apply to ship components.

4. New Features and Modules:

Added new Expansion Modules for damage and rate of fire, collision and signature dampening, enriching ship customization options.

Introduced a Hand Tractor Tool with advanced distance control and visual effects, including a schematic for crafting.

Implemented a Tractor Capture Bubble to scoop items being tractored into the ship's storage.

Added a hostile logistics ship what repairs its squad members during combat, you may want to target those first unless your ships alpha damage is high enough to burn through the shields, armor and reps.

[previewyoutube=wHpdZ3Yzy6A;full][/previewyoutube]

Vertical Hanger Prototype added, with auto-ascending floors and functional hanger doors, integrating smoothly with ship operations.

5. Optimizations:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/4c3dd1c6d5344116cc6711d9a66f879f1347e468.png

Simplified and cleaned up code related to ship module monitoring and collision systems, resulting in more efficient game performance.


6. Asteroid Mining and Exploration:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/aea7daaa3e72ca241de55288c4f8fecb4cf588d8.png

Improvements to Asteroid Mining, including UI updates and bug fixes, making resource collection more engaging.

7. Additional Updates:

Fixed Cursor Capture and Movement Lock bugs in the settings menu, enhancing user control.
Integrated a new Card System for discovered objects, allowing players to manage and track items more effectively.

Updated Space Dock, Damaged & Undamaged with new icons and visual improvements.


8. Continued Enhancements:

Updated Module Readouts to display percentage bonuses for Rate of Fire, Damage, etc., ensuring that stats are correctly applied and visible to players.

These updates demonstrate our commitment to enhancing the gameplay experience in Warped Space, with significant improvements across UI, ship systems, mission mechanics, and more. 
We look forward to continuing this journey with our community!


Stay tuned for more exciting updates and developments in the coming months!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/adacaca36bdebfce561e9b08cebc21753d89c4ac.png

Greetings, fellow space explorers! It's time for another thrilling update on our sci-fi space survival game. We've been hard at work expanding the universe and enhancing your gameplay experience. Without further ado, let's dive into what we've accomplished over the last few weeks:

Encounter Alien Outposts: (Placeholder Visuals)   
Prepare yourself for captivating encounters with alien outposts! We've dedicated some time to crafting unique experiences for each outpost. Whether you prefer a loud or a stealthy approach, there's something for everyone. Get ready for intense pew-pew action or employ your cunning skills to outsmart your extraterrestrial foes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/8f0b78edbf5fa30bc80761c7f36c381e6d602cd0.png

Improved HUD Info: 
We also spent some time to refine the Tractor, Salvage, Mining, Scanning, and Combat Mode HUD Info. These improvements will provide you with vital information at a glance, allowing for more seamless and immersive gameplay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/e6e4320ad48abd6815f13c0b13f81e45d29e998b.png

Beware of Space Bugs and Critters: 
We've added captivating Space Bugs and Critters to encounter during your exploration or Caves etc. Brace yourself for thrilling surprises and be ready for any unexpected challenges that may arise.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/a4648137ce117c53ff094b2452b3f31d7fc3c61f.png

Enhanced Player Status Panel:
Your survival is our top priority! We've worked on the Player Status Panel, ensuring it now displays when your health or oxygen levels drop below 80%. Stay informed about your vital stats and take the necessary actions to keep yourself alive in the vastness of space.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/07ac7cd6dab46885b542b50e81de3f9006d8a505.png

Ui Visual Update: 
We believe that visual excellence is crucial in creating an immersive gaming experience. Numerous 3D models and their UI counterpart sprites have received some updates, bringing the visuals up to our coveted Sliver Standard. While we strive for perfection, we're proud of the progress we've made so far.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/f08b0f05ecbe3ead8a82691c3e667050e8b7163b.png

Intelligent Hostile AI:
Brace yourselves for even more thrilling encounters! We've bolstered the AI capabilities of hostile ships, allowing them to make strategic decisions. Hostile ships will now choose to engage in close combat before skillfully evading damage or opt for long-range battles. Additionally, we've introduced two new hostile AI variants: the agile Light Fighter (w) and the formidable Light Fighter (v). These variants, along with the three testing alien outposts, promise distinct behaviors and new challenges - if you're a "earliest-access" backer your feedback is most welcome here ;)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/3180c63574d6079dac2365416c13af63e9c53154.png

A Sneak Peek into the Future:
We are hard at work exploring various layouts for the upcoming update to the inventory and player setup panels. While we continue to refine these elements, we're excited to offer you a glimpse of what's to come. Stay tuned for an even more streamlined and immersive gaming experience!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/fa3cbcd7e5362cdcb8f1acd54c94b9ae5c91cc00.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39770474/960ad1fbf4d46c98b6436ad4796fe4ab658c7a1d.png

That concludes our third progress report! We're thrilled to share these exciting updates with you. 
As always, your feedback and support drive us forward. Together, we'll embark on an epic space survival adventure like no other. Keep exploring, stay vigilant, and prepare for the challenges that lie ahead. See you in the stars, explorers!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6GqiiOFCgLQ

I look forward to hearing your ideas for the game as it progresses out of proof of concept towards a fleshed-out game.
